The **Cultist Blade** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

An improvised weapon made from an antler piece combined with a piece of metal crudely formed into a serrated blade, and engraved with cultist emblems. Requires one to be level 10 to use. Repairing the weapon requires Black Titanium.
